violations.text: The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. Owner/operator has successfully completed an approved course in food safety management. Owner/operator must register with RIDOH Center for Food Protection as the Certified Food Safety Manager. Application provided. New Violation. Correct By: 09/25/2026

The quaternary ammonium concentration in the sanitizing solution of the 3-bay sink was 0 parts per million (ppm). According to the manufacturer's use directions, the concentration of the quaternary ammonium must be 200 - 400 ppm. Sanitizer bottle observed to be empty. Bottle was replaced during inspection. Concentration 200 ppm. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/16/2026

Ambient temperature of walk-in cooler and dairy reach-in observed held at 43 degrees Fahrenheit. Milk observed with temperature of 41 degrees F. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Service call placed during inspection. Temperatures of TCS foods are to be carefully monitored and TCS foods disposed of if temperatures are above 41 degrees F for more than 4 hours. Walk-in cooler must maintain a temperature at/below 41 degrees F. New Violation. Correct By: 09/16/2026

The entrance doors are not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 09/25/2026
Refrigerator door gasket of the walk-in cooler observed in poor repair, split away from the door. Gasket is to be replaced. New Violation. Correct By: 09/30/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the dairy reach-in shelving have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Shelving is to be cleaned. New Violation. Correct By: 09/18/2026

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. Employee(s) must register and successfully complete an approved course in food safety management. A certified employee must then register with RIDOH Center for Food Protection as the Certified Food Safety Manager. New Violation. Correct By: 09/30/2025

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (ice machine) were observed with an accumulation of black and brown residues. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Ice machine is being cleaned and sanitized. New Violation. Correct By: 09/04/2025

The entrance doors are not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 09/04/2025
Gasket of the walk-in cooler is in poor repair and is being held in place with tape. Gasket must be properly repaired/replaced. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 09/04/2025
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the quaternary ammonium sanitizing solution for the 3-bay sink. New Violation. Correct By: 09/08/2025

The entrance doors are not tight-fitting. Space observed between the 2 doors. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 04/15/2024
Door gasket of the walk-in cooler observed in poor repair. Gasket is to be properly repaired/replaced. New Violation. Correct By: 05/08/2024
